transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been feeling incredibly stressed and anxious lately. About two weeks ago, I went through a really traumatic event, and I just can't stop reliving it. It keeps playing over and over in my head, and I really need some help.
Since the traumatic event, have you also been having nightmares, feeling numb or detached, or avoiding reminders of what happened?

Yes, I've been having awful nightmares about the event that wake me up in a panic. I'm also doing everything I can to avoid thinking about it, and I've been staying away from the place where it happened and avoiding anyone who might bring it up.
How long has it been since the traumatic event happened? Have these symptoms lasted for less than a month or more than a month?
It happened exactly two weeks ago. So, I've been dealing with all of this for about two weeks now, which is definitely less than a month.
Since it happened, have you felt detached from yourself or your surroundings, like things weren’t real or like you were watching yourself from outside your body?

No, I haven't really felt that way. I don't feel detached from myself or my surroundings, and everything still feels very real. It's more that the memories of what happened are just too intense and vivid.
Since the event, have you been feeling constantly on edge, easily startled, irritable, or having trouble sleeping or concentrating?
No, I haven't really experienced those specific feelings. I don't feel constantly on edge, easily startled, or irritable. My focus and concentration have been okay for the most part.
Have these symptoms been interfering with your daily life, like your work, relationships, or ability to do normal activities?
I'm not quite sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about how it's affecting my daily life, work, or relationships yet because I've just been trying to cope with the memories day by day.
Since this started, have you missed work or school, pulled away from other people, or stopped doing things you normally do because of these symptoms?

Yes, I've definitely been pulling away from my normal routine and staying away from people. I am avoiding certain places and activities because they remind me of what happened and trigger so much distress. It has just felt easier to stay isolated and avoid those reminders entirely.
Since the event, have you also had upsetting thoughts pop in suddenly, trouble feeling positive emotions, or felt unusually alert to danger even when you were safe?

Yes, I definitely have upsetting thoughts and memories about the event suddenly pop into my head all the time. As for having trouble feeling positive emotions or feeling unusually alert to danger, I haven't really noticed that or I'm not sure.
Since the event, have you found it hard to feel positive emotions like happiness, love, or satisfaction, even at times when you normally would?

I haven't really noticed that or I'm not sure. My main struggles have been dealing with the distressing memories and trying to avoid anything that reminds me of what happened, rather than not being able to feel happy.
Have there been any important parts of the traumatic event that you can’t remember, even though you feel like you should be able to?
No, I haven't experienced any memory loss about what happened. In fact, I remember the entire event all too well, and the details are still very vivid in my mind.
